answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 93 identities per epoch. Audits are written down in dawn, queued in bridge, and inlet publishes the wait time. A farm of 137 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3040 identities would post 3434 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
